defmodule DbDriver.Auth do
  @moduledoc "Cross-service authentication for database driver connections"

  @base_config_path "/etc/dbdriver/configs"
  @allowed_services ["analytics", "reporting", "ingestion", "monitoring"]

  defstruct [:service_name, :token, :config_path, :permissions]

  def authenticate(service_name, token, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, normalized} <- normalize_service_name(service_name),
         {:ok, _} <- validate_token_format(token),
         {:ok, config} <- load_service_config(normalized, opts),
         {:ok, perms} <- verify_token_against_config(token, config) do
      {:ok, %__MODULE__{service_name: normalized, token: token, config_path: config.path, permissions: perms}}
    end
  end

  defp normalize_service_name(name) when is_binary(name) do
    normalized = name
      |> String.downcase()
      |> String.replace(~r/[^a-z0-9_\-]/, "")
      |> collapse_separators()
    
    case normalized do
      "" -> {:error, :invalid_service_name}
      _ -> {:ok, normalized}
    end
  end
  defp normalize_service_name(_), do: {:error, :invalid_service_name}

  defp collapse_separators(str) do
    str
    |> String.replace(~r/\-{2,}/, "-")
    |> String.replace(~r/_{2,}/, "_")
  end

  defp validate_token_format(token) when is_binary(token) do
    if String.length(token) >= 32 and String.match?(token, ~r/^[A-Za-z0-9+\/=_\-]+$/) do
      {:ok, token}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_token_format}
    end
  end
  defp validate_token_format(_), do: {:error, :invalid_token_format}

  defp load_service_config(service_name, opts) do
    base_path = Keyword.get(opts, :config_base, @base_config_path)
    config_file = resolve_config_path(base_path, service_name)
    
    case File.read(config_file) do
      {:ok, content} ->
        config = parse_config(content)
        {:ok, Map.put(config, :path, config_file)}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:config_load_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_config_path(base_path, service_name) do
    # Service names are flat identifiers, no hierarchy
    # Validated to contain only [a-z0-9_-] by normalize_service_name
    file_name = service_name <> ".toml"
    Path.join(base_path, file_name)
  end

  defp parse_config(content) do
    # Simplified TOML-like parser for service config
    lines = String.split(content, "\n")
    Enum.reduce(lines, %{}, fn line, acc ->
      case String.split(String.trim(line), "=", parts: 2) do
        [key, value] -> Map.put(acc, String.trim(key), String.trim(value))
        _ -> acc
      end
    end)
  end

  defp verify_token_against_config(token, config) do
    expected_hash = Map.get(config, "token_hash", "")
    computed_hash = :crypto.hash(:sha256, token) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
    
    if secure_compare(computed_hash, expected_hash) do
      permissions = Map.get(config, "permissions", "read")
        |> String.split(",")
        |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
      {:ok, permissions}
    else
      {:error, :authentication_failed}
    end
  end

  # Use the vetted constant-time comparison primitive from :crypto instead
  # of a hand-rolled implementation. hash_equals/2 avoids leaking length
  # information and is not susceptible to implementation mistakes.
  defp secure_compare(a, b) when is_binary(a) and is_binary(b) do
    :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
  rescue
    _ -> false
  end
  defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false
end

defmodule DbDriver.Connection do
  @moduledoc "Database connection manager with cross-service auth"

  def connect(service_name, token, db_opts \\ []) do
    auth_opts = Keyword.get(db_opts, :auth_opts, [])
    
    case DbDriver.Auth.authenticate(service_name, token, auth_opts) do
      {:ok, auth} ->
        pool_key = {auth.service_name, auth.permissions}
        {:ok, %{auth: auth, pool_key: pool_key, connected_at: System.system_time(:second)}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end
